test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He speaks English ______ than I do.
solution:
The correct answer is '**better**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**better**" is the comparative form of "**good**."
 
• In this sentence, a comparison is being made between how the subject and another person speak English.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He speaks English **better**__ than I do."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ("best") is incorrect because "best" is the superlative form, which is used when comparing more than two entities.
 
• Option 3 ("more good") is grammatically incorrect because "better" is the correct comparative form of "good."
 
• Option 4 ("good") is incorrect because the base form of the adjective cannot be used in a comparative context.
